title: His Engines Died. He Landed Two Planes. #AviationHistory #Shorts
description:
Two training planes collided over a small Australian town in 1940. They stayed locked together, and pilot Leonard Fuller had to find a way to land both. A paper diorama retells the Brocklesby midair collision.

Music: “Signal to Noise” (No Piano Melody) by Scott Buckley — released under CC BY 4.0. https://www.scottbuckley.com.au/library/signal-to-noise/ · https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ · Edited and mixed for this video.
